question.text: An open-ended Cat III AIF scheme's corpus falls BELOW the INR 20 crore minimum. Under SEBI Circular on open-ended Cat III schemes, what is the fund's obligation?

answer.text: Intimate SEBI within 7 days; restore within 12 months or wind up
Intimate SEBI within 2 days of receiving the redemption request triggering the breach; restore corpus within 3 months OR redeem ALL investors
Breach is permitted up to 3 consecutive quarters

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular CIR/IMD/DF/14/2014, if an open-ended Cat III scheme's corpus falls below INR 20 crore: (i) fund intimates SEBI within 2 days of receiving the redemption request that triggers the breach; (ii) fund must bring corpus back to INR 20 cr within 3 months OR redeem ALL investors entirely. Repeated violations may attract SEBI action. The Trap: Options A, C, D mis-state the timelines. Only 2-day intimation + 3-month cure is correct. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests this. XIX-E embeds it in open-ended Cat III operations.
